achievements.name: Fist of the Immortal
achievements.description: All achievements unlocked! Thank you for playing.

achievements.name: The Old Grandmaster
achievements.description: Complete the prologue.

achievements.name: The Assault
achievements.description: Defeat Fajar, the boss at the end of the Squats.

achievements.name: The Hateful Pole Fighter
achievements.description: Defeat Sean, the boss at the end of the Club.

achievements.name: A Lady's Blood in the Snow
achievements.description: Defeat Kuroki, the boss at the end of the Museum.

achievements.name: Lady Wing Chun
achievements.description: Defeat Jinfeng, the boss at the end of the Tower.

achievements.name: Furious Fists
achievements.description: Defeat Yang, the final boss at the Sanctuary.

achievements.name: Muk Yan Master
achievements.description: Obtain the Wood talisman by sparing the first boss.

achievements.name: Tiger on Fire
achievements.description: Obtain the Fire talisman by sparing the second boss.

achievements.name: Source of Flying Daggers
achievements.description: Obtain the Water talisman by sparing the third boss.

achievements.name: Iron Money
achievements.description: Obtain the Metal talisman by sparing the fourth boss.

achievements.name: Legendary Talismans of Wuxing
achievements.description: Obtain the Earth talisman and attain Wude by sparing every boss.

achievements.name: Scareless
achievements.description: Beat the game while being 50 years old or less.

achievements.name: Prodigal Child
achievements.description: Beat the game while being 25 years old or less.

achievements.name: Kill Nil
achievements.description: Beat any boss without dying.

achievements.name: Detective Story
achievements.description: Complete the Squats' detective board.

achievements.name: Drunken Fighter
achievements.description: Complete the Club's detective board.

achievements.name: Martial Artist
achievements.description: Complete the Museum's detective board.

achievements.name: Knowledge Greed
achievements.description: Complete the Tower's detective board.

achievements.name: Healing Memory
achievements.description: Complete the Sanctuary's detective board.

achievements.name: Stuntmaster
achievements.description: Climbing and going across the environment allows you to control the flow of the fight.

achievements.name: Dance of the Praying Mantis
achievements.description: Throwing enemies around makes handling big groups easier. (Ignored in training mode.)

achievements.name: Street Fighting
achievements.description: Anything can be a weapon, so keep using your environment to your advantage. All is fair in such fights! (Ignored in training mode.)

achievements.name: Life is your teacher
achievements.description: Unlock your first skill.

achievements.name: State of constant learning
achievements.description: Permanently unlock a skill for the first time.

achievements.name: Qi Gong: Mind
achievements.description: Receive the highest XP-based shrine reward for the first time.

achievements.name: Qi Gong: Breath
achievements.description: Receive the highest score-based shrine reward for the first time.

achievements.name: Qi Gong: Essence
achievements.description: Receive the highest age-based shrine reward for the first time.

achievements.name: The 36th Chamber of Kung-Fu
achievements.description: Bare handed or with a weapon, standing up, against a wall, a ledge, or on the ground... Perform each takedown type at least once.

achievements.name: Master of the Phoenix Eye Fist
achievements.description: Use each Focus Attack at least once. (Ignored in introduction level.)

achievements.name: I know Kung-Fu
achievements.description: Reach a level score of 10 000.

achievements.name: Ferocity, speed, strength, accuracy
achievements.description: Reach a level score of 20 000.

achievements.name: Old Child
achievements.description: Reach your oldest appearance. Will you still have enough strength left to reach your goal?

achievements.name: Sword Stained With Blood
achievements.description: Successfully use a blade weapon's one-shot attack on an enemy. (Ignored in training mode.)

achievements.name: Lightning Hands
achievements.description: Perform 3 takedowns within 12 seconds. (Ignored in introduction level.)

achievements.name: Kung-Fu Tussle
achievements.description: Hit 3 enemies in a single strike. (Ignored in introduction level.)

achievements.name: Path of the Prospect
achievements.description: Unlock the special Calbot move.

achievements.name: Rumble in the Hangar
achievements.description: In the Squats, clear the hangar in less than 1 minute 20 seconds after being detected by the main group.

achievements.name: The Pit Protector
achievements.description: In the Club's pit, beat the Juggernaut before any other enemy is beaten.

achievements.name: Be like water my friend
achievements.description: In the Museum, throw an enemy into the fountain from a higher floor.

achievements.name: Take damage to save time
achievements.description: In the Tower's caves, drop from a high point to get deeper faster.

achievements.name: Warriors from the Mountain
achievements.description: In the Sanctuary, throw an enemy into the mountains.

achievements.name: Come Snap With Me
achievements.description: Give the Photo Mode a shot!

achievements.name: Project Arena
achievements.description: Unlock a new arena pack.

achievements.name: Diligence as a goal
achievements.description: Get 3 stamps in any arena challenge.

achievements.name: Bloody Sport
achievements.description: Clear 25 different arena challenges.

achievements.name: Martial Hub
achievements.description: Clear 45 different arena challenges.

achievements.name: Deadly Venom
achievements.description: Earn a gold stamp on a Manhunt arena challenge.

achievements.name: Secure, Protect, Leave
achievements.description: Earn a gold stamp on a Capture arena challenge.

achievements.name: The best strikes are the ones we avoid
achievements.description: Earn a gold stamp on a Survival arena challenge.

achievements.name: A Touch of Acumen
achievements.description: Earn a gold stamp on a Performance (time) arena challenge.

achievements.name: Crouching Tiger
achievements.description: Clear all tiger arena challenges.

achievements.name: Hidden Dragon
achievements.description: Clear all dragon arena challenges.

achievements.name: Skill and an even stronger will
achievements.description: Collect 240 stamps in arenas.

achievements.name: Master of the Flying Assassins
achievements.description: Clear any challenge of the Heliport arena by throwing all enemies out.

achievements.name: Here Cometh the Iceman
achievements.description: Finish the target with a snowball in the "Cyclone" arena challenge.

achievements.name: Fighter in the Pond
achievements.description: Throw the Disciple in the lake in the "Bellowing Mountains" arena challenge.

achievements.name: Bonus Stage
achievements.description: In the Car Club arena, destroy the parked car near your spawn.

achievements.name: Beatmaker
achievements.description: In the Showtime! arena, roll across the mixing equipment in the side room repeatedly.

achievements.name: Fight the way you practice
achievements.description: Clear an arena challenge with the Custom Mode enabled.

achievements.name: A Bit Of Everything, Simultaneously
achievements.description: Attempt to clear any level with the Modifiers Randomizer enabled.
